items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lalo Schifrin was the musical arranger of that program and the arranger of my recording called Conga Soul. There are several numbers there composed by him and me.

ctx.x: Lalo Schifrin was the arranger for the famous television series, Mission Impossible. Lalo Schifrin was the musical arranger of that program and the arranger of my recording called Conga Soul. There are several numbers there composed by him and me. Many, many but yes . . . Conga Soul.
Maestro, some of your many accomplishments, because there have been so many throughout your career . . . you pioneered the use of multiple congas.
